sentences: The first element is 3 so ok becomes 1 and the loop keeps it.
When a[i] equals 3, ok turns 1 and later checks leave it there.
The if sets ok to 1 on matching values and the else just moves on.
Since 3 appears early, ok stays 1 through the whole loop.
The last three elements do not match 3, so ok remains 1 from before.
